text:
maria: Proposal — when a primary model is saturated, automatically fall back to a compatible variant that preserves tenant-region affinity and prefers same-region quantized variants. Want API header + console toggle + telemetry reason codes. Sketch below.

kevin: What's the decision boundary? cost vs latency tradeoff?

maria: Criteria: tenant tier override > region affinity > model compatibility > cost delta threshold. Example policy snippet:
```
{
  "fallback_policy": "region_pref",
  "prefer_same_region": true,
  "allowed_variants": ["quant-8", "float16"],
  "reason_header": "x-rw-fallback-reason"
}
```

anya: Two asks: return `x-rw-variant` in response so clients know which variant served; emit telemetry `fallback.event` with `reason_code` and `primary_util`.

oliver: Also decide on 429 handling. Do we surface 429 (caller-visible) or silently reroute? I'd prefer silent reroute by default and an opt-in strict mode that returns 429 when primary is overloaded.

kevin: Console UX — add per-tenant override on Rollouts page: dropdown with `Prefer local variant / Allow silent reroute / Strict primary only`. Need audit trail and sample traces for each change.

routebot: staging:fallback-dryrun enabled for region_pref policy (records fallback events, doesn't reroute) :gear:

maria: Run dry-run for 48h and collect metrics: `fallback.rate`, `fallback.latency.delta_ms`, `fallback.cost.delta_usd`, broken down by tenant, model, region.

anya: + histogram of token latency deltas per tenant. Alert if fallback_rate > 5% for silver+ or >1% for gold.

kevin: SDK change: expose header `x-rw-fallback-policy: region=soft;strict=false` and client will map to `Prefer-Variant` shorthand. Also surface `x-rw-variant` and `x-rw-fallback-reason` in responses.

maria: Agreed. Next steps: implement router changes (kevin), add telemetry schema (anya), console toggle and audit logs (kevin + oliver), run 48h dry-run, then small canary reroute for low-risk tenants. Ping ops to watch alerts.

sara: Ops acked. I'll watch staging metrics and open PagerDuty if fallback.latency.delta_ms p95 > 500ms for gold tenants.

maria: Thanks — I'll add a short RFC doc and put links here when ready. :thumbsup:
